description: Books an estimate visit with ONE contractor the person chose whose listing shows luma.books_online. The contractor calls the person to confirm the time. Call it once without consent to get consent_text, show it, and call again with consent=true only if they agree.

address.description: The address of the job, as the person gave it for this booking.

consent.description: True only if the person read and agreed to consent_text.

job.description: What the job is, in the person's words.

phone.description: A 10-digit phone number the contractor calls to confirm.

preferred_times.description: Optional: days and times that suit them.

site.description: Or the Luma site from the listing's luma.site.

slug.description: The listing slug from find_businesses (a listing with luma.books_online).

name: book_estimate
title: Book an estimate visit
